newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-CVRD still an outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CVRD still an outperform.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Dean Witter said it was maintaining its outperform rating on Brazilian mining giant Cia Vale do Rio Doce following its release Wednesday of first-half results.

-- "The company posted strong earnings in the (second) quarter and we believe this, along with post-privatization cost improvements..., will continue to provide positive momentum for the stock," Morgan Stanley analyst Hillary Kircher Peruzzi said.

-- CVRD posted a second-quarter net income of 171 million reais ($159 million) or 0.44 reais ($0.41) per ADR, a sharp hike from 81 million reais or 0.21 reais per ADR in 1997's first quarter, she said.
-- For the first half, net income reached 252 million reais or 0.65 reais per ADR, up 121 percent from 111 million reais or 0.29 reais per ADR in 1996's first half, she added.
-- "We consider the second-quarter 1997 results to be very good, revealing significant operational improvements over both the previous quarter and the the prior year," the analyst wrote.
-- CVRD preferred was up 0.38 percent at 28.90 reais while its common was flat at Wednesday's close of 25.20 reais at noon/1500 gmt/1100 edt in Sao Paulo.
